description: B12 lifecycle hooks for Grok (PreCompact staging + SessionEnd extraction). Thin wrappers that delegate to the shared B12 core (no duplication of patterns, merge logic, or engines).

PreCompact.description: Stage high-value memories from the session transcript before compaction using B12 shared engines.

SessionEnd.description: Extract decisions, gotchas, learnings, and progress from the completed session and store them via B12.
